name: cash_roundings_with_currency_links
note: AccountCashRounding strategy/rounding_method plus the currency_ids link count (addons/account/models/account_cash_rounding.py:72), the m2m the invoice rounding picks from; read-only replay over the whole population
source_sql: SELECT r.id, r.strategy, r.rounding_method, count(c.res_currency_id) AS currencies FROM account_cash_rounding r LEFT JOIN account_cash_rounding_res_currency_rel c ON c.account_cash_rounding_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.id
